DONE. Gerrit change 1407 (https://rebar.solutions.navateam.com/c/rebar/+/1407) MERGED to main at patch set 4 with LLM-Review +1 AND Verified +1. CI conclusion: success, zero failed jobs across the full matrix (ubuntu py3.11/3.12/3.13 + macos py3.13, plus optionality, golden-path, artifact-probe, eval-discipline, verify-identity, pip-audit, lint+type-check and all twelve pre-suite drift gates). 599 insertions, 98 deletions across 21 files. Ticket closed; all 14 acceptance criteria ticked.

RESIDUAL-GAP DISPOSITION SWEEP

Surface-parity census - all five slots dispositioned:
- CLI (rebar review): IN SCOPE, proven - test_cli_review_alias.py plus E2E through the real binary against the real store.
- MCP tool (review_ticket): IN SCOPE, proven - test_mcp_tool_emits_one_signal asserts exactly one signal per invocation.
- Library facade (rebar.llm.review_ticket): IN SCOPE, proven - test_public_warns_impl_is_silent plus the fourteen unedited direct callers.
- Automated callers (review_workflows.diff_review_paths, evals/eval_solver): IN SCOPE, proven silent via _review_ticket_impl.
- Dual-direction (mirror read/write op): OUT OF SCOPE, accepted - review is read-only; there is no mirror write operation to keep in parity.

Test exclusions: none. Contention cases: not applicable - this change composes no locked operations, adds no retry/backoff, and introduces no cache over store state, so the op-level contention triggers do not fire.

Escalation compromises: none. The standard-tier implementer got the happy path green in one dispatch; no tier escalation was needed.

Deferred advisories: the LLM-Review bot reported 2 non-blocking advisory findings on ps3 but did not itemize them in its message and left no inline comments, so there is nothing actionable to file. ACCEPTED.

FILED as follow-up: 1 ticket - see the discovered_from link on this ticket for the derived-artifact documentation gap, which cost four CI iterations here.
